description: brightwind is a Python library for wind-resource data processing and assessment, published by BrightWind developers. The IEA Wind Task 43 Awesome Wind listing describes functions specifically for wind resource assessments, and the native package registry describes wind-resource data processing. This establishes a supporting role in wind-energy assessment and capacity planning. Coverage depends on the wind measurement data supplied by the user; no geographic study boundary, fixed time period or input resolution is prescribed by the inspected metadata. The software is available through its public GitHub repository and Python package registry under the MIT licence. The registry reports version 2.7.0 and dependencies including pandas, NumPy, SciPy and scikit-learn; it does not establish a particular simulation algorithm or validated performance. Access to package and repository metadata is public. No installation, execution, code, README, package archive or dataset was retrieved. A limitation is that supported input formats, exact assessment routines and validation cases were not inspected and remain unstated. The repository is not marked archived, but that does not guarantee maintenance or support. No active brightwind record was found. Three prior candidate rows refer to this same repository, including a candidate-to-candidate duplicate; this addition would resolve that existing lead. Related wind tools occur in the same source list, but the inspected metadata does not establish direct interoperability.
